To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the relationship between R&D and technological strength is not strong, possibly because of the inclusion of much R&D on ongoing operations, (ii) the relationship between technological strength and firm performance, measured as operating profits, is strong and positive, and (iii) the relationship between firm size and productivity, measured as sales per employee, and firm performance, is strong and negative, meaning that larger firms with higher productivity perform worse.
the relationship between R&D and technological strength was not significant, but that the relationship between technological strength and firm performance was significant.
the impact of R&D on firm performance is quite weak, and that the impact of technological strength on firm performance is much stronger.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between technology strategy, technological strength, and firm performance.
the relationship between the firm's technology strategy and its performance.
the relationship between firm strategy and firm performance, with a specific focus on the impact of technology strategy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the link between R&D and technological strength is weak, but that the link between the latter and firm performance is strong.
technology strategy has a positive and significant impact on firm performance.
the impact of technological strength on firm performance was found to be positive and significant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the technology strategy of a firm is an important determinant of firm performance.
the impact of technology on firm performance is mediated by the firm's technological strength.
the technology strategy and the resulting firm technology measures have a strong influence on firm performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the link between R&D and firm performance is quite complex and that a comprehensive technology strategy is needed to ensure the link between technology and firm performance is strong.
firms should focus on the development of technological strengths and not just on the development of technology per se.
technology is a critical driver of firm performance, but that technology strategy and the technology portfolio must be managed carefully.
